|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Set 1)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #1a sheet (PDF made 5 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “Deploy on Han (except TK-422), even as a 'react'. May target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target hit (opponent loses 1 Force), and its forfeit = 0, if destiny + 1 > defense value. May fire once during your control phase for 1 Force.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Virtual Set #1 sheet hosted by Decipher (PDF made 6 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “Deploy on Han (except TK-422), even as a 'react'. May target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target hit (opponent loses 1 Force), and its forfeit = 0, if destiny + 1 > defense value. May fire once during your control phase for 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same as the previous version; the slip's look differs (Decipher's sheet prints Dark Side text boxes black on white and prints collector numbers V1•1–V1•12; the 5 March sheet prints Dark Side boxes white on black and no numbers). Listed as its own version because it is a separate publication (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Set 1) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 1: Legacy, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on Han (except TK-422), even as a ‘react.’ May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, its forfeit = 0, and opponent loses 1 Force if destiny +1 > defense value. Once during your control phase, may fire using 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' “'react'.” → “‘react.’”; added “or creature”; “hit (opponent loses 1 Force), and” → “hit,”; added “and opponent loses 1 Force”; “+ 1” → “+1”; “May fire once” → “Once”; “phase for” → “phase, may fire using”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20050813215254/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/virtual/VirtualCards1.pdf#page=1 VirtualCards1.pdf] — the Virtual Set #1 sheet hosted by Decipher (PDF made 6 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002); page 1, slip 4.
